defects.impact: The returned (successful, tunnel) tuple is always truthy when non-empty, including (false, null), so the intended grown-tunnel retry loop does not retry failed tuple results.
Requested connector count cannot be inferred from requested loop count or process exit status.

defects.evidence: gen_axis_points_file iterates each tunnel but assigns aps = mesh_generator.aps_of_tunnels and avs = mesh_generator.avs_of_tunnels
defects.impact: The global axis set is repeated under each tunnel hash, so axis.txt cannot be accepted as per-tunnel ground truth without an independent audit or adapter.

decision: A one-world original export smoke can still test native mesh/SDF production, but mesh executability and topology-ground-truth validity must be reported separately. axis.txt is presumed invalid as GT until evidence disproves the source-level defect.
